summary: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing Hong Kong Stock Exchange approval to spin off its Jiaxing Park infrastructure assets via an Infrastructure REIT listing on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange (SZSE). The REIT will be publicly offered with CICC Fund as manager. No price per share, premium, or other financial terms were disclosed. The spin-off satisfies PN15 of Hong Kong Listing Rules, and a waiver from assured entitlement to shareholders was granted. The transaction is expected to close upon SZSE approval; watch for regulatory clearance and REIT pricing dynamics.
